en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Shuayb, from Abu Al Sabbah who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘We<sup>asws</sup> are a people, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Necessitated obedience to us<sup>asws</sup>. For us<sup>asws</sup> is the Anfal and for us<sup>asws</sup> is the clean wealth’.
en.sarwar: 16. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn Mahbub from Durays al-Kunnas who has said the following.

“Abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) said, “Why people get the course of adultery?” I said, “I do not know, May Allah take my soul in service for your cause.” He said, “It is because of not paying our al-Khums (one fifth religious dues) except our pure Shi‘a. It helps cleans their birth.”
